verdict: First run of a deliberately small fixture book. Ground truth is clean (0 violations, 7-entity corpus written before this run existed) and coverage of the batch roster is complete, but the run surfaced three real, generic pipeline bugs invisible to a 5-page book's ground-truth corpus: a hyphenated character name gets silently truncated in its structured identity (STU-767), front matter glued into a single-spine-item chapter becomes both a phantom character page and the book's highest-salience EVENT page (STU-768), and a fairy-tale opener misfires the flashback-cue detector (STU-769). Relation quality (100% generic evolution, 0% key_moments) is likely inherent to a one-chapter book with no cross-chapter arc, not a defect, and Flopsy's roster drop was a corpus/YAML gap, now fixed by widening ner.character_names to all four siblings — needs a re-run to confirm. Priority for next run: verify STU-767/768/769 fixes and the character_names widening together (they're independent, one re-run covers all three) before treating this book as a stable smoke fixture.

verdict: This run's own extraction/wiki-preparation stages (epub_data.json 20:16, persons_full.json 20:08, events.json 20:18, batches 20:18) executed BEFORE STU-767/768/769's fixes landed (commits 20:17-20:27), so the run does not actually validate those fixes despite running after they were filed: FREDERICK WARNE is still a phantom entity and the highest-salience EVENT page still renders the raw glued front-matter blob (STU-768's exact symptom), and chapter summaries stayed on the extractive path so STU-769's flashback-detector fix is untested either way. STU-767's fix DID land in time for entity_extraction specifically (entities_classified.json regenerated 20:16:17, one minute before the commit, using the uncommitted local diff already applied) and correctly produced 'Cotton-tail' with Flopsy now on the roster (character_names widening confirmed working, 7 entities up from 6). But the wiki-pages generation stage served a stale global map-cache entry from run 1 (cached_at 18:49:27, pre-dating every fix today) whose title field still reads the old truncated 'Cotton', producing a duplicate page alongside the freshly-generated correct 'Cotton-tail' page — filed as STU-771, exact re-dispatch mechanism not yet pinned. Ground-truth validation still reads 0 violations, but that is because the corpus has no entry for Cotton/FREDERICK WARNE at all (an extra/wrong entity trips no signal), not evidence those pages are correct. Priority for next run: clear .studio/runs/map-cache before re-running now that all three of STU-767/768/769 are fully merged, and set generation.chapter_summary.mode: llm at least once to actually exercise STU-769's fix.
